sourceCoverage: Corrected runtime/test input hashes and all-suite execution recorded here; the commit containing this evidence identifies the verified successor. No source changes occurred after checks.

findings.status: REPRODUCED AND FIXED (remaining competition entry); post-game ad/reporting flow ALREADY FIXED
findings.evidence: Original main lacks the launch coordinator. Current base already connects root country/Apple evidence and claimed result exits to actual notices/choices. Current-base Compete saved its purpose choice but never called eligibility preparation; fresh users depended on a game-result visit. Now the real Compete screen starts independent eligibility only after saved terms and native dismissal, without ad notice or either SDK initialization. Rendered terms tests plus actual coordinator tests cover all four adult countries, failed save, cancellation and retained existing ad eligibility.

launchProcessingControl -> verifyLaunchAgeEvidence -> launchProcessingPolicy is the active four-country path. The legacy US/CA regionalPolicy is not the active launch-country resolver. Actual coordinator tests exercise US/CA/AU/MX adult permission/refusal/restart; CA14+/AU15+ teen choices and independent withdrawal; unsupported/unknown/declined and parental-authority-required paths remain restricted. No territory change or new guardian-permission collector.

findings.status: REPRODUCED AND FIXED (competition stop); reporting controls ALREADY FIXED
findings.evidence: Info already renders independent reporting controls via PrivacyChoices -> refuseProcessingPurpose -> withdrawAdPerformanceReporting, including actual save/native confirmation and rendered retry after both failures. stopOnlineCompetition had no production screen caller. Info now exposes it independently, retaining retry through remount after unconfirmed storage and never stopping permitted ads/reporting. Support/deletion remain exposed outside eligibility gating. No competition control added to the result privacy sheet.

Active launch plan derives treatment/underAgeOfConsent from country-specific thresholds and central access forwards the plan, bypassing the old generic teen-only derivation. Real coordinator-to-Google tests verify TEEN and UMP false for eligible CA/AU teens and US teens. Added actual-coordinator checks verify CHILD/underAgeOfConsent true and no SDK load where CA13/AU13-14/MXminor lack verified guardian authority. Existing adapter CHILD mapping tests remain. No fictitious parental grant was added to make an eligible-child test pass; the production app does not collect that authority.

findings.status: ALREADY FIXED in successor source; artifact alignment remains open
findings.evidence: Live privacy policy read September20 describes Info > Privacy & choices, separate reporting, CT clarification and optional result-exit setup, matching current production paths. Lobby calls requiredOnly; game.tsx claims result action before preparePostGamePrivacy. Source f4b191d was already remote; completed work was pushed first at6248c71. Existing artifact04cf2e97 contains the prior corrected manifest/regional/rights implementation but not this follow-up competition wiring. It is not a final acceptance candidate.
